keyword: where is the players championship played
claims: The Players Championship is played annually at the TPC Sawgrass Stadium Course in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.
The TPC Sawgrass Stadium Course has been a permanent home for the Players Championship since 1982.
The TPC Sawgrass Stadium Course has a design by Pete Dye and Deane Beman.
The TPC Sawgrass Stadium Course features the par-3 17th "Island Green" hole.
The Players Championship is held in March.
The TPC Sawgrass serves as the headquarters for the PGA Tour
